result.title: LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications
result.summary: Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 LexiCan，一种为 3D 点云选取唯一轨道代表的字典序规范化方法，声称在 O(3)/SO(3) 下可证不变、在 QM9 与 QM-sym 上经验不变性达约 1e-6 埃、缓解不连续跳变且速度显著更快，并能提升分子性质预测与 ModelNet40 形状分类。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及多模态推理，但其关于表示几何、唯一轨道代表选取及不变性误差与不连续跳变的讨论，可能为核查 latent 视觉状态中同等变换下的表示稳定性与连续性提供概念线索。
